metadata.description: Two-subscription model routing for Claude Code: a Claude architect, GPT Luna/Sol/Astra lanes through the Codex CLI, an optional free LM Studio lane, a mandatory Fable 5.1 review, live usage monitoring (the Pantry) and a model talent registry (the Potato Council). Homage to Dan McAteer's astrable and fable-advisor.

plugins.name: astrafabulopus
plugins.description: Architect-as-orchestrator on your choice of Claude session model: specs and verdicts stay with the architect; GPT Luna does routine typing, GPT Sol takes hard one-offs, GPT Astra is the occasional frontier lane and second advisor, LM Studio is the free slow lane, Fable 5.1 reviews every deliverable, the Pantry routes around whichever subscription is running low, and the Potato Council remembers which model is good at what.
